name: Reimbursement of tuition fee and examination fee for girls under Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Tuition Fee Scholarship Scheme (100% Tuition Fee + Exam Fee).
description: The scheme provides course fee reimbursement for students applying for MBBS,BDS,BAMS,BHMS,BPTH,BOTH,B.SC Nursing, BUMS, BP & O, BASLP in government aided/Corporation/Private un-aided colleges. Beneficiary Category: EBC/OPEN Eligible Courses: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BPTH ,BOTH,B.SC Nursing, BUMS, BP & O, BASLP in government aided/Corporation/Private un-aided colleges.
